derivation: from a primitive root meaning to engrave;
def: a chisel or graver; also a style forwriting

words.word: in it with a mans pen

occurrences.text: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz.
